{{Quote|He's a bunny, I'm a dog. We're dangerous, but we work cheap.|Unidentified sentient dog|<ref name="JKGuide" />}}
An '''unidentified sentient dog''' was a member of the [[Dog/Legends|dog]] species who worked with [[Max (bunny)|Max]]. He noted that he and his business partner were dangerous, but cheap.<ref name="JKGuide">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sam_and_Max-Adventurer_4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sam & Max parodying ''The Empire Strikes Back'' in ''[[The Adventurer 4]]'']]
The dog in question is most likely a reference to [[W:c:samandmax:Sam|Sam]], the other half of the [[Wikipedia:Sam & Max|Sam & Max]] comic and video game duo.<ref name="Telltale">{{WebCite|url=http://www.telltalegames.com/samandmax|text=Telltale Games — Sam & Max|archivedate=20060518195610}}</ref> Sam and his partner appeared in a number of comics published in [[LucasArts]]' ''[[The Adventurer]]'' magazine, including a number of ''[[Star Wars]]'' parodies.<ref name="TA 4">[[The Adventurer 4|''The Adventurer'' 4]]</ref><ref name="TA 5">[[The Adventurer 5|''The Adventurer'' 5]]</ref><ref name="TA 9">[[The Adventurer 9|''The Adventurer'' 9]]</ref>
